About this Property

Sagewood Neighborhood house in SW Bend.  Three bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms plus an office and bonus room with 2554 square feet. This home is located in the Sagewood Neighborhood of SW Bend off Century Drive on the way to Tetherow and Mt. Bachelor.  The south end of the Deschutes River Trail is just a few short blocks away.

Walk in the front door to find Hickory flooring throughout the open living space.  Featured in the living room are a vaulted ceiling and a gas fireplace.  Stainless steel appliances, granite countertops and a walk in pantry make the kitchen more than just a place to cook.  Just outside the kitchen is a paver patio with a covered BBQ area.

Also located on the main level is the spacious primary bedroom which includes a vaulted ceiling.  The primary bathroom has tile floors, a tiled walk in shower, private commode and large, carpeted walk in closet.

At the top of the stairs you will find an oversized bonus/family room with vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light.  The office is just down the hall as are the other two bedrooms and the guest bathroom.  The guest bathroom includes plenty of counter space and a tub/shower combo.

This home is heated by a forced air gas furnace and cooled with air conditioning.

There is a gated dog run on the side of the house.  Pets will be considered on a case by case basis.  Any approved pets will require additional deposits
